summary: The retired-claim delta re-renders every line the locus deleted since the stamp on every tick of a rotation, because nothing records that a tick searched them
acceptance: the sweep window draws the retired-claim delta from the retired-claim cursor, a tick that searched advances it while the stamp stays put, and a claim is searched once per rotation rather than once per tick
tests: the retired-claim delta renders the lines deleted since the retired-claim cursor
a sweep state carrying no retired-claim cursor draws the delta from the stamp
notes: Ruled off the retired-claim-cursor record, fork (1). Constraint: the live sweep state carries no such field and only the sweep slice may rewrite it, so a required field refuses that slice's own window and it cannot repair itself — absent reads as the stamp. `AnyCursorField` (`harness/planState.ts`) derives the table from string-valued fields and an optional one does not extend `string`. Measured: 852 deleted lines against a 1200-line budget.
